title: Mathematical Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the ➗️mathematical plugin from its old 8-crate constitutional layout (🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact, 🎛️apps/➗️mathematical app facade, and 6 module crates: ⚙️engine/🗣️dsl/🔧️op/🎒️pack/📡️protocol/🖱️ui) to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/➗️mathematical/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following .🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md precisely. This is batch-3 work under the CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE master ticket. Stay strictly inside ✏️s/🔌️plugins/➗️mathematical/**. Never edit root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, registry script, .vscode/launch.json, or other plugins' directories — end with a registrar handoff block instead.
summary: Migrated the ➗️mathematical plugin from its old 8-crate constitutional layout to the new single-crate taxonomy layout at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/➗️mathematical/📦️packages/🦀️rust (semio-s-plugin-mathematical), following TEMPLATE.md precisely. Single artifact (mathematical), single app, single mode (edit) with two windows (graph/geometry), no panels/options (none existed in the old manifest). 7 MathCommand variants decomposed via app_commands! into 4 command-group files (document/graph/geometry/locale), preserving exact row order and dsl wire keys. Confirmed and forward-fixed the known TEMPLATE §12.3 pre-existing corruption in the old 🖱️ui crate (unbalanced Ok( wraps, missing Fault import) as part of porting handle() into typed command handlers. All 55 new-crate tests pass (vs 21 compilable-baseline + 15 forward-ported UI-crate tests that never ran pre-migration), cargo check/wasm32-wasip2 check/clippy -D warnings all clean, taxonomy audit clean, wire format byte-identical to the pre-migration baseline for all 7 command variants (9 dumped cases incl. both Option branches of SetAlgorithm). Repointed the one real external dependent (dsl fixture-sweep crate's dev-dependency on the deleted old facade crate) to the new plugin crate — found the path had already been auto-repointed by a concurrent process, only added the explanatory comment. Found two real framework/recipe gaps, both documented inline and in the ticket's verification.txt: (1) TEMPLATE §13's `workspace = true, package = "..."` rename pattern does not work — Cargo resolves workspace-dependency inheritance by the local key, not the package override; worked around by keeping renamed aliases as plain path+package deps. (2) `app_commands!` unconditionally derives Serialize/Deserialize on the generated Command enum, but the framework's `dsl::Wire` type (used transitively by this plugin's DSL-mirror types) implements neither; worked around with a hand-rolled Serialize/Deserialize on MathGraphDsl that round-trips through the already-serde-able MathGraph shape, entirely within this plugin's own files. Deleted all 8 old crate directories after the new crate was fully green. Root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and the registry/launch.json were never touched — left for the registrar per the handoff block.
